_about: Structured schema metadata for SCDE canonical DB. Source of truth for column descriptions used by tooltips in any report or schema-explorer agent. Generated from: ERD PDF caveats, SC Financial Accounting Handbook FY2526, SCEIS field reference, original upload file headers. Update this file when schema changes; db/init.sql comments are derived from it.

_conventions.description_length: ≤200 chars for tooltip-friendly display; full handbook definitions live in code_accounting_codes.Full_Description

dim_district.purpose: Canonical dimension for SC public school districts. Resolves the naming convention drift across ADM (short names), WPU/Headcount (long names), and District_ID-bearing files.

columns.District_ID: Zero-padded 4-digit SC district ID, e.g. '0160'. Preferred join key when available.
columns.District_Name: Canonical display name for reports. Defaults to long form ('Abbeville 60').
columns.normalized_name: Lowercased, whitespace-stripped form for fuzzy joins where ID is unavailable.
columns.short_name: Short form used by ADM files ('Abbeville', 'Anderson 1').
columns.long_name: Long form used by WPU and Headcount files ('Abbeville 60', 'Anderson 01').
columns.source_files: Array of file basenames where this district appears. Useful for coverage audits.

dim_fiscal_year.purpose: Fiscal year reference. SCDE FY runs July 1 to June 30. SY label matches the spanning school year (FY2025 = SY 2024-25).

columns.FY: Fiscal year as four-digit ending year (FY ending June 30, 2025 = 2025).

code_accounting_codes.purpose: The authoritative SC Financial Accounting Handbook code catalog. Source for tooltip descriptions on every code rendered in any report.

columns.Code: 3-4 digit handbook code. Note: Function and Object codes overlap numerically (100-700); always filter on Type to disambiguate.
columns.Type: One of 'Revenue' (252 codes, 1000-5999), 'Function' (131 codes, 100-600 for expenditure purpose), 'Object' (104 codes, 100-700 for expenditure type).
columns.Full_Name: Official handbook title, often ALL CAPS for top-level categories.
columns.Display_Name: Truncated label for narrow report columns (~30 chars).
columns.Short_Description: 1-2 sentence description suitable for hover tooltips. Populated for all 487 codes.
columns.Full_Description: Complete handbook definition, can run several paragraphs. ~90% populated; falls back to Short_Description when missing.

code_district_funding_streams.purpose: District-facing inventory of revenue streams with rollup hierarchy. Drives the bucket categorization in the comparison reports (SAC Required, Local District Services, State Other, Federal, etc.).

columns.REV_Code: Revenue code; mostly matches code_accounting_codes.Code where Type='Revenue'. Suffixed codes (3103H, 3103E) represent subdivisions of a parent SCEIS code that roll up.
columns.Category: Bucket name used in comparison reports (Taxes & Fees, District Services, Investments, State Aid to Classrooms, Property Tax Reimbursement, etc.).
columns.Source_System: Originating system: LARS, SCEIS, PowerSchool ADM, etc.
columns.Allocation_Basis: Allocation method for the stream: 'PowerSchool ADM', 'PS ADM', 'Categorical', or 'District FTEs'. Sourced from the 'Allocation Data' column of the State sheet in District_Funding_Stream_Inventory.xlsx. NULL for Federal and Local sheet rows (column not present on those sheets). Used by funding-projections agent to route each REV_Code to the correct projection method.
columns.Sunset_Note: Free-text note from the inventory flagging time-limited or closed streams, e.g. 'Closed, last paid FY23'. Used by funding-projections agent to force projected amount to zero after the sunset year. NULL when no sunset applies.

code_historical_revenue_codes.purpose: Retired or time-limited revenue codes no longer in the current SC Financial Accounting Handbook but still present in historical lea_revenues data. Prevents unmapped-code warnings for valid CARES Act and other emergency-fund codes. Read-only reference — do not assign new amounts against these codes.
code_historical_revenue_codes.source: Manually curated by code-catalog agent from CARES Act statutory references and prior handbook editions

columns.Code: 3-4 digit revenue code. Same numeric space as code_accounting_codes.Code where Type='Revenue'; never overlaps with current codes.
columns.Type: Always 'Revenue' in current data. Included for PK symmetry with code_accounting_codes to enable UNION-safe queries.
columns.Full_Name: Official or reconstructed full title of the funding program.
columns.Display_Name: Short label for narrow report columns (~30 chars).
columns.Short_Description: 1-2 sentence description suitable for hover tooltips. Describes program authority and time-limited nature.
columns.Full_Description: Complete definition including statutory authority, distribution method, and successor codes where applicable.
columns.Last_Active_FY: Last fiscal year in which this code was expected to carry non-zero amounts. Entries after this year are likely audit reconciliation entries.
columns.Program_Authority: Statutory or regulatory citation (e.g., 'CARES Act Sec. 18002 (P.L. 116-136)').

code_handbook_definitions.purpose: Terminology glossary parsed from the handbook .docx. Definitions for terms that aren't codes themselves (e.g., 'Fund', 'Encumbrance', 'Indirect Cost').

columns.Term: Defined term as it appears in the handbook glossary.
columns.Category: Revenue / Function / Object / Fund / General — the section the term lives in.

policy_rate_assumptions.purpose: Annual policy inputs for funding-projection formulas. Stores per-pupil rate parameters (e.g., SAC base per WPU, employer contribution per WPU) keyed by fiscal year and scenario. Seeded manually from the SC Appropriations Act; the funding-projections agent reads these rates when computing SAC formula projections.

columns.FY: Fiscal year the rate is effective for (4-digit ending year, e.g. 2025).
columns.scenario: Projection scenario name. 'baseline' is the default; future scenarios include 'flat_funding', 'bsc_+3pct'.
columns.value: Rate value in per-pupil dollars, stored to 4 decimal places to accommodate fractional rates.
columns.source: Statutory or regulatory citation for the rate, e.g. 'SC Appropriations Act 2024-25, Part IB §1A.1'.
columns.notes: Optional supplementary notes about the parameter or any adjustments made.

lookup_gl_account.purpose: Bridge from 10-digit SAP G/L accounts (used in SCEIS) to 3-4 digit handbook codes. Expenditure side (5xxx) sourced from the SCDE-published 'Expenditure GL Account Descriptions - March 2025.pdf' group map (99.4% of 5xxx rows). Revenue side (4xxx) is mechanical pattern extraction (79% of 4xxx rows) pending a canonical revenue crosswalk. Balance-sheet (1-3xxx) and clearing (7xxx) accounts are intentionally unmapped — the handbook has no codes for those concepts. Always filter consumer joins on `code_accounting_codes.Type = lookup_gl_account.Handbook_Type` — 251 Object codes overlap numerically with Function codes and will double-count otherwise.
lookup_gl_account.source: data/uploads/Expenditure GL Account Descriptions - March 2025.pdf for 5xxx; mechanical digit extraction for 4xxx; balance-sheet/clearing accounts deliberately excluded.

columns.SAP_Category: Inferred from leading digit: 1xxx asset, 2xxx liability, 3xxx fund balance, 4xxx revenue, 5xxx expenditure, 6-7xxx clearing.
columns.Handbook_Code: Matched 3-4 digit handbook code. NULL for unmapped rows.
columns.Handbook_Type: Revenue / Object — the category the matched code falls under. NULL for unmapped rows.
columns.Handbook_Name: Display name from code_accounting_codes for the matched code.
columns.Bridge_Type: Mapping classification: 'pdf_crosswalk' = sourced from the SCDE expenditure PDF; 'mechanical' = digit-pattern extraction hit a valid handbook code; 'unmapped' = no handbook match (balance-sheet, clearing, depreciation, ACFR, or operational orphan). Explicit 'unmapped' is preferred over NULL so consumers can filter deterministically.
columns.Source: Per-row provenance tag: 'pdf_crosswalk_group_map', 'mechanical_pos2-5', 'balance_sheet_excluded', 'depreciation_excluded', 'acfr_excluded', 'clearing_excluded', or 'interfund_excluded'. Distinguishes mapped rows by source and explains why each unmapped row was deliberately left out.
columns.Confidence: Mapping confidence tier: 'high' for PDF and mechanical matches; 'n/a' for intentionally unmapped rows.
columns.Notes: Human-readable rationale for the mapping decision — group name from the PDF, the digit-extraction result, or the reason a row is intentionally unmapped. Especially load-bearing for high-dollar orphans like the $6.07B GL 5170500000.
columns.Source_Row_Count: Row count of this GL_Account in sceis_detail_transaction at the time the staging parquet was generated. Used for triage — high-row-count unmapped accounts are higher priority to resolve.

lookup_sceis_program_classification.purpose: Curated regex rules that classify sceis_fi_payments.Reference into a Funding_Stream (State / Federal / Other) and Program_Tag (EIA, ESSER, Title I-IV, IDEA, SAC, etc.). Lowest Rule_Order wins on multi-match. Joined via the vw_sceis_fi_payments_classified view.
lookup_sceis_program_classification.source: Curated 2026-04-27 from token analysis of the Reference column across FY23-26 FI Payments. Validates 97.6% of district-attributed dollars (79.5% State, 18.2% Federal) with 22 rules.
load_caveats: Reference is truncated to ~10 characters in the source xlsx, which limits classification of some programs (e.g., 'STRONGE' = Stronger Connections grant). The 'Other / unmatched' bucket is mostly truncation artifacts.
EIA payments are monthly — the same program shows ~12x per FY. Don't double-count if aggregating to annual.
Pattern is evaluated against UPPER(regexp_replace(Reference, '^\d{4}[\s\-_]*', '')) — the District_ID prefix is stripped first.

columns.Rule_Order: Priority — lowest wins on multi-match. Convention: 10-190 = federal acronyms, 200-290 = state acronyms, 900+ = period-prefix catchalls.
columns.Source: Provenance — when/how the rule was added.

vw_sceis_fi_payments_classified.purpose: View — sceis_fi_payments left-joined to lookup_sceis_program_classification, exposing Funding_Stream and Program_Tag columns. Use this view (not the raw table) for any State/Federal split or per-program analysis.
vw_sceis_fi_payments_classified.source: View defined in init.sql; recomputes on every query.

columns.Funding_Stream: 'State' / 'Federal' / 'Other' from the classification rules. NULL Reference rows fall through to 'Other / unmatched'.
columns.Program_Tag: Short program name; 'unmatched' for rows that no rule matched.
columns.Classification_Rule_Order: Rule_Order of the rule that matched. NULL = no rule matched.

vw_revenue_code_status.purpose: View — global statewide-dormancy mask for Revenue codes. Owned by code-catalog; computed from code_district_funding_streams joined to lea_revenues. Consumers must filter on Is_Statewide_Dormant = FALSE unless explicitly auditing the catalog. Auto-refreshes from lea_revenues on every query.
vw_revenue_code_status.source: View defined in init.sql. Dormancy rule: leaf-level code (Rollup_Level >= 3) with statewide $0 across each of the last 3 reported FYs (Reported_Flag=TRUE) and no Sunset_Note.

columns.REV_Code: Revenue code primary key; joins to code_district_funding_streams.REV_Code and lea_revenues.Revenue_Code.
columns.Rollup_Level: Hierarchy depth 1-4 from code_district_funding_streams; codes at level >= 3 are leaf-level and subject to dormancy evaluation.
columns.Display_Title: Short display title inherited from code_district_funding_streams; use for report labels.
columns.Sunset_Note: Free-text sunset note from code_district_funding_streams; non-NULL means the stream is intentionally closed, not dormant.
columns.Last_Active_FY: Most recent fiscal year in which this code had any nonzero statewide reported amount; NULL if the code has never had activity in lea_revenues.
columns.Is_Rollup: TRUE when Rollup_Level <= 2 (parent/category row); rollup rows are never dormant regardless of dollar totals.
columns.Has_Sunset: TRUE when Sunset_Note is non-NULL; sunset codes are excluded from dormancy classification (they are intentionally closed, not statewide-zero by accident).
columns.Is_Statewide_Dormant: TRUE when Rollup_Level >= 3 AND Sunset_Note IS NULL AND statewide sum across the last 3 reported FYs equals $0. Filter on FALSE to exclude dormant codes from reports and marts.

sceis_agency_master.purpose: Canonical dimension for H630 (SCDE) organizational structure. Joins to detail transactions on four equivalent keys: Cost_Center, Functional_Area, AGY_Funded_Program, State_Funded_Program.

columns.Cost_Center: SAP cost center, e.g. 'H630000010'. Primary join key.
columns.Name: Cost center display name.
columns.Mini_Code: 4-digit short reference code that links to handbook.

sceis_detail_transaction.purpose: Core fact table for H630 SCEIS G/L postings. CRITICAL: amounts are signed by the H/S indicator; never abs() before aggregation.

columns.GL_Account: 10-digit SAP G/L; joins to lookup_gl_account for handbook-level grouping.
columns.Posting_Date: Date the transaction was posted to the ledger.
columns.Document_Type: BI, Z7, PY, AA, SK, etc. — categorizes the kind of transaction.
columns.Ref_Doc_Number: Originating document; may equal Doc_Number for primary postings.
columns.Debit_Credit_Ind: H (Haben/credit) or S (Soll/debit). Determines sign of Debit_Credit_Amount.
columns.Debit_Credit_Amount: SIGNED amount: H rows are negative, S rows positive. Aggregations using abs() are typically wrong.

sceis_fi_payments.purpose: Vendor invoice and payment clearing data from SAP FI module — the state's audited system of record for SCDE outflows. Authoritative over lea_revenues / lea_expenditures wherever the same flow appears in both. District_ID is derived from the Reference column (validated against dim_district), letting state-to-district transfers be aggregated without a separate vendor crosswalk.
sceis_fi_payments.source: FI_Payments_by_Vendor_FY23..FY26_YTD.xlsx · 123,218 rows across 4 fiscal years · loaded by data/staging/load_sceis_fi_payments.py
load_caveats: Two subtotal rows per file ('Result' and 'Overall Result') have null Doc_Number and are skipped at load.
Clearing_Doc_Number is not present in the current export and is loaded as NULL; ERD documents the intended join to sceis_detail_transaction.Doc_Number.
District_ID coverage by amount: ~92% per FY. The unmatched ~8% is genuine non-district vendor spending (statewide contracts, agency operations).

3 dim_district IDs do not appear in FI Payments: 5208 (DJJ), 5209 (DOC), 5364 (Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities). They receive direct agency appropriations, not state aid through this stream.

columns.Doc_Number: FI document number (the invoice itself). Does NOT match sceis_detail_transaction.Doc_Number.
columns.Item: Line item within the FI document.
columns.Posting_Date: Date the invoice was posted to the ledger.
columns.Clearing_Doc_Number: JOINS to sceis_detail_transaction.Doc_Number when present. NULL in the current export; carried in schema for future loads.
columns.Fiscal_Year: Derived from Fiscal_Period suffix. Use this for grouping rather than parsing the period string.
columns.Reference: Free-text payment reference. For district payments, begins with the 4-digit District_ID followed by program/period info (e.g., '0160 EIA 7 JUL'). For non-district vendors, contains invoice numbers, period ranges, or descriptors ('VARIOUS', '#').
columns.District_ID: Derived 4-digit District_ID, validated against dim_district. NULL when Reference does not start with /^\d{4}/ or when the prefix is not a known District_ID — naive prefix-without-validation would falsely attribute vendor invoice fragments (e.g., AMERIGAS '8059', UNIFIRST '2110') to nonexistent districts.
columns.Source_File: Originating xlsx filename, for provenance and reload diagnostics.

sceis_fmeddw.purpose: SAP Funds Management Drilldown (FMEDDW) extract — document-level FM postings: budget appropriations, transfers, carryforward, allocations, and GM-module actuals consumption. Owned by the internal-budget agent. Powers the internal-facing budget vs actuals dashboard at app_internal/. Each row = one FM document line. Budget-vs-actuals roll-ups are derived via vw_budget_vs_actuals_by_funds_center; do not aggregate this table directly without the Budget_Type filters documented in the internal-budget agent.
sceis_fmeddw.source: data/uploads/4-3 FMEDDW.xlsx · 4,276 rows · single FY (currently FY26 through period 10) · loaded by scripts/ingest_fmeddw.py
load_caveats: Each FMEDDW extract is single-FY. The ingest script TRUNCATEs and reloads — do not re-run with a different-FY file unless you intend to overwrite the previous one. Multi-FY analysis needs a separate strategy.

FMEDDW Actuals (GM Budget Doc Type, Process=Receive) measure budget authority consumed, NOT the full FI ledger. They will not match SUM(sceis_detail_transaction.Debit_Credit_Amount) for the same Funds Center, by design. Do not reconcile the two — they measure different things.
8-character Funds Center values are FM hierarchy rollup parents (e.g. 'H6300000') and are flagged Is_Rollup=TRUE. Filter Is_Rollup=FALSE for any per-center aggregation, or budget will double-count.
GM Budget Doc Type rows always appear as matched Send/Receive pairs within the same Entry Document. Sum only Process='Receive' for actuals; summing both nets to zero.
ESTIMATED REVENUE Budget_Type is revenue-side budget, kept separate from expenditure budget in the view's Estimated_Revenue column.
Source xlsx has two columns named 'Document Status' — string ('Posted'/'Preposted Posted') and integer (1/3). The integer is renamed to Document_Status_Code at load time.

columns.Entry_Document: FM document number — primary key together with Entry_Document_Line.
columns.Entry_Document_Line: Line within the FM document, zero-padded string ('000001', '000002', ...).
columns.Document_Date: Date the FM document was created.
columns.Document_Year: Calendar year of Document_Date as a string ('2026'). Distinct from Fiscal_Year.
columns.Version: FM budget version. Always '0' (operative budget) in current data; non-zero versions would be scenarios/drafts.
columns.Entry_Document_Type: SAP FM document type: APPR (appropriation), TRFW (transfer), GM01 (grants management), BDAJ (adjustment), CFWD (carryforward), SUPP (supplemental), IATR (inter-agency), ALOC (allocation), CFGF (carryforward general fund), OSB2 (2% appropriation).
columns.Process: FM movement direction: 'Enter' (positive budget entry), 'Receive' (positive transfer in or actuals consumed), 'Send' (negative transfer out or GM offset), 'Supplement' (positive adjustment), 'Carry For. Recv' (carryforward receipt), 'Return' (negative adjustment).
columns.Created_On: Timestamp the document was posted in SAP.
columns.Fiscal_Year: SC fiscal year (Jul-Jun). Single value across the current extract.
columns.Budget_Type: Drives the budget-vs-actuals pivot. See internal-budget agent for the taxonomy: ORIGINAL APPROPRIATIONS, SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATIONS, BUDGET ADJUSTMENTS, Carryforward Gen Fund, Carryforward Special Items, 2% APPROPRIATION BUDGET, TRANSFER OF APPROPRIATIONS, TRANSFER OF SALARY/FRINGE, INTER-AGENCY TRANSFER, ALLOCATIONS-TRSFRS FR EMPL BEN, ESTIMATED REVENUE, GM Budget Doc Type.
columns.Fund: FM Fund — partitions budget authority by funding source (general fund, EIA, federal pass-through, etc.).
columns.Funds_Center: FM organizational object. 10-character codes are leaf cost centers (one director's responsibility); 8-character codes are rollup parents in the FM hierarchy.
columns.Commitment_Item: FM commitment item — maps to a G/L account family. Drill-down dimension below Funds_Center.
columns.Functional_Area: Functional classification from the SAP CO module.
columns.Grant: Mostly 'NOT RELEVANT' — only populated for grant-funded postings.
columns.Document_Status: 'Posted' or 'Preposted Posted'. Both are fully settled — Preposted means the document was pre-posted then posted, NOT pending.
columns.Document_Status_Code: Numeric code matching Document_Status: 1 = Posted, 3 = Preposted Posted.
columns.Funded_Program: FM funded program — finer-grained than Funds_Center, often the legislatively-named program receiving the budget.
columns.Amount: Total of Transactions in Local Currency. SIGNED — Send entries are negative, Receive/Enter/Supplement entries are positive. Never abs() before aggregation.
columns.Is_Rollup: TRUE when LEN(Funds_Center)=8 — these are FM hierarchy parent nodes. Filter Is_Rollup=FALSE for any per-center aggregation.
columns.Source_File: Originating xlsx filename, for provenance and reload diagnostics.

vw_budget_vs_actuals_by_funds_center.purpose: View — pivots sceis_fmeddw document rows into (Funds_Center, Fiscal_Year) → Total_Budget, Estimated_Revenue, Actuals, Available, Pct_Consumed. Owned by the internal-budget agent. The canonical input to the internal-facing budget vs actuals dashboard at app_internal/. Excludes Is_Rollup rows so per-center totals don't double-count the agency rollup.
vw_budget_vs_actuals_by_funds_center.source: Computed from sceis_fmeddw on every query.

columns.Total_Budget: Sum of all expenditure-side budget entries: ORIGINAL APPROPRIATIONS + SUPPLEMENTAL + BUDGET ADJUSTMENTS + Carryforward (Gen Fund + Special Items) + 2% APPROPRIATION BUDGET + all transfer types (TRANSFER OF APPROPRIATIONS, TRANSFER OF SALARY/FRINGE, INTER-AGENCY TRANSFER, ALLOCATIONS-TRSFRS FR EMPL BEN). Transfers net signed across Receive (+) and Send (-).
columns.Estimated_Revenue: Sum of ESTIMATED REVENUE entries — revenue-side budget, kept separate from Total_Budget so it doesn't inflate spending authority.
columns.Actuals: Sum of GM Budget Doc Type rows where Process='Receive'. Measures budget authority consumed via the SAP Grants Management module. NOT the same as FI ledger spend; do not reconcile against sceis_detail_transaction.
columns.Available: Total_Budget - Actuals. May be negative if a Funds Center has overspent its current authority pending adjustment.
columns.Pct_Consumed: Actuals / Total_Budget when Total_Budget > 0; NULL otherwise. Already a fraction (0.85 = 85%), not a percent.

lea_revenues.purpose: District-level annual revenue, normalized to tidy form. Source files are wide-pivot with districts as columns; this table is the unpivoted result. District self-reported, NOT the system of record — see Reported_Flag for submission status.
lea_revenues.source: Revenue_FY2022-23 through FY2024-25.xlsx · 3 fiscal years · district self-reported
submission_caveats: The source xlsx pre-fills each district's column with literal zeros across all leaf revenue codes; non-submitting districts therefore appear as $0 across every row, indistinguishable from a district that genuinely had $0 in a code without further analysis.

Reported_Flag distinguishes the two cases: TRUE = at least one nonzero leaf row in that (District_ID, FY); FALSE = entire column is zero (not submitted, OR structurally correct e.g. Barnwell 45/48 post-merger).

20 (District_ID, FY) combos are FALSE: chronic gaps (Jasper 01 across all 3 FYs), structurally correct merger zeros (Barnwell 0601 pre-FY25, Barnwell 45/48 post-FY24), Governor's Schools 5364/5395 (not regular districts and don't submit), and an FY25 cohort still mid-submission (Beaufort 01, Greenwood 50, Lancaster 01, Laurens 55, Saluda 01, Clarendon 06).
Aggregations and statewide weighted averages should filter on Reported_Flag = TRUE; otherwise template-zero districts deflate per-pupil rates and inflate apparent district counts.

columns.Revenue_Code: Joins to code_accounting_codes (Type='Revenue'). 92% match rate against handbook.
columns.Amount: Annual revenue dollars for this district + code combination. Self-reported by the district; SCEIS (sceis_fi_payments) is authoritative wherever the same flow appears in both.
columns.Reported_Flag: TRUE if the district reported any nonzero leaf row in this FY; FALSE = template-zero across the entire column. Derived per (District_ID, FY) and denormalized onto every row of that group. Filter on Reported_Flag = TRUE for any aggregation that should reflect actual submitted revenue.

lea_expenditures.purpose: District-level annual expenditures by FUNCTION code (purpose: Instruction, Support Services), not by Object code (type: Salaries, Supplies). For Object-level district spending, source data is not available in the current upload set. District self-reported, NOT the system of record.
lea_expenditures.source: Expenditure_FY2022-23 through FY2024-25.xlsx · 3 fiscal years · district self-reported · NOT YET LOADED (table is empty pending a load_lea_expenditures.py loader)
submission_caveats: Source xlsx is wide-pivot with the same template-zero pattern as lea_revenues — non-submitting districts pre-fill with literal zeros across all leaf rows. Reported_Flag must be derived per (District_ID, FY) at load time, identical to the lea_revenues convention.
Statewide aggregations and per-pupil expenditure rates MUST filter on Reported_Flag = TRUE.

columns.Amount: Annual expenditure dollars for this district + function code. Self-reported by the district; SCEIS (sceis_fi_payments / sceis_detail_transaction) is authoritative wherever the same flow appears in both.
columns.Reported_Flag: TRUE if the district reported any nonzero leaf row in this FY; FALSE = template-zero across the entire column. Derived per (District_ID, FY) and denormalized onto every row of that group. Same semantics as lea_revenues.Reported_Flag. Filter on TRUE for aggregations.

lea_adm_counts.purpose: Average Daily Membership at the 135-day report cycle (mid-year, SCEIS-sourced). Drives WPU funding calculations. Distinct from lea_headcounts.

columns.School_Code: SCDE school code; null for district-level rollup rows.
columns.SY: School year (4-digit ending year, e.g. 2025 = SY 2024-25).
columns.Report_Cycle: Always 135 in current files (SCDE also uses 45-day and 180-day cycles).

lea_headcounts.purpose: Active enrollment headcount at the 45-day report cycle, sourced from PowerSchool QDC1. Distinct from ADM: counts unique students rather than averaging daily presence. Used as per-pupil denominator in comparison reports.

columns.Total_Active_Enrollment: Sum across all grades. 'Active' = EntryCode 'E' AND Included in State Reporting = 'Y'.
columns.K5_count: Kindergarten (5-year-old) headcount. Note: ADM uses 'K', headcount uses 'K5'.

lea_wpu_allocations.purpose: Weighted Pupil Units and EFA funding calculations. Each pupil category carries a different weight; ADM × weight = WPU. Schema drifted across years — earlier years include allocation columns that later years dropped. Supports both 45-day (preliminary) and 135-day (funding-final) cycle data; use Report_Cycle to distinguish.
lea_wpu_allocations.source: WPU13521 through WPU_13525.xlsx · 5 fiscal years (135-day); WPU04522 through WPU04526.xlsx · 5 fiscal years (45-day)

columns.Category: Pupil category: Kindergarten, Primary, Elementary, Special Ed tiers, etc.
columns.Report_Cycle: Days into the school year when the count was taken (45 or 135). 45-day is preliminary/early-year; 135-day is the funding-final measure.
columns.ADM_135_Day: 135-day Average Daily Membership for this category.
columns.Weighted_Pupils: ADM × category weight = the WPU figure.
columns.State_Allocation: State EFA funding for this category. Null for FY23+ (column dropped from source files).
columns.Local_Required_Support: District local match. Null for FY23+.
columns.Audit_Standard: Audit standard amount. Null for FY23+.

lookup_district_exclusions.purpose: Report-time filter listing special schools and non-traditional LEAs that must be excluded from all district-comparison reports. Data is retained in source tables; this table is joined at query time to suppress rows. Supports per-scope and time-bounded exclusions for forward flexibility.
lookup_district_exclusions.source: Manually seeded by code-catalog agent 2026-04-28. Add rows here; do not delete source data.

columns.District_ID: Zero-padded 4-digit SC district ID. Joins to dim_district.District_ID. The district remains in dim_district and all fact tables — this entry only triggers report-time suppression.
columns.Exclude_Scope: Scope of the exclusion: 'all_reports' suppresses the district everywhere; 'statewide_aggregates_only' removes from weighted-average calculations but keeps in detail views; 'comparison_charts_only' hides from peer charts. Extensible — add new scope values without a migration.
columns.Effective_FY_From: SMALLINT. First fiscal year (4-digit ending year) this exclusion applies. NULL = no lower bound (applies from the beginning of data).
columns.Effective_FY_To: SMALLINT. Last fiscal year (4-digit ending year) this exclusion applies. NULL = no upper bound (applies indefinitely).
columns.Reason: Human-readable explanation for why the district is excluded. Required — must not be empty.
columns.Notes: Optional supplementary notes, e.g. statutory reference or ticket number.
columns.Created_At: Timestamp when this exclusion row was inserted. Auto-populated by DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.

mart_district_revenue_rollup.purpose: Denormalized rollup joining lea_revenues to code_district_funding_streams + code_accounting_codes. Powers all three modes of the report-district-revenue agent. Rebuilt by that agent when source data changes.

columns.Category: Bucket name used in comparison reports.
columns.Rollup_Level: 1-4 hierarchy depth for detail mode rendering.
columns.Amount: Annual revenue dollars (signed; revenues are positive).

mart_funding_projections.purpose: Funding projections by district, revenue code, and scenario. Owned by the funding-projections agent (not yet implemented). Rebuilt by that agent's pipeline SQL. Stores point estimates and 80% prediction-interval bounds from either the SAC formula method or trend-based OLS regression.

columns.Revenue_Code: Revenue code being projected; joins to code_accounting_codes (Type='Revenue') and code_district_funding_streams.
columns.Allocation_Basis: Allocation method copied from code_district_funding_streams.Allocation_Basis. Determines which projection method was applied.
columns.Lower_80: Lower bound of the 80% prediction interval for the projected amount.
columns.Upper_80: Upper bound of the 80% prediction interval for the projected amount.
columns.Method: Projection method applied: 'formula_sac' (SAC per-WPU formula), 'trend_ols' (ordinary least-squares trend), 'sunset_zero' (forced to zero after sunset year), or 'insufficient_history' (fewer than 3 data points).
columns.Scenario: Projection scenario; matches policy_rate_assumptions.scenario. 'baseline' is the default for v1.
columns.Built_At: Timestamp when this row was computed and inserted by the funding-projections agent pipeline.

dim_district_geometry.purpose: Geographic dimension for SC school districts: maps SCDE District_ID to its US Census TIGER GEOID, polygon geometry (as GeoJSON text), and shapely-computed geographic centroid. One row per District_ID. Districts without a fixed territory (statewide charters, special-purpose schools, Barnwell merger remnants) are present as Has_Geometry=FALSE rows so joins from fact tables are 1:1 across the full dim_district.
dim_district_geometry.source: Loaded 2026-04-28 from data/geo/sc_districts.geojson (extracted from data/uploads/sc-districts-map.html, US Census TIGER vintage). Crosswalk built by code-catalog via name-matching against dim_district. Florence 01 (2101) geometry is the shapely.unary_union of the original Florence 01 polygon and the pre-2013 Florence 4 polygon (GEOID 4502220), per user adjudication 2026-04-28.

columns.District_ID: Zero-padded 4-digit SC district ID. PRIMARY KEY. Joins 1:1 to dim_district.District_ID for all 83 entries.
columns.GEOID: US Census TIGER GEOID (e.g., '4503000' for McCormick). NULL for the 11 districts without a fixed geographic boundary (statewide charters, special-purpose schools, Barnwell merger remnants).
columns.District_Name_Normalized: Display-ready district name. For matched rows this is the SCDE District_Name (e.g., 'Greenville 01'); for any unmatched cases this would fall back to the GeoJSON NAME. Required.
columns.GeoJSON_Name: Original NAME property from the Census GeoJSON feature (e.g., 'Greenville County School District'). NULL for no-geometry rows. Useful for traceability back to the source.
columns.LSAD: US Census Legal/Statistical Area Description code from the GeoJSON feature. Typically '00' for school district areas. NULL for no-geometry rows.
columns.Geometry_GeoJSON: Full feature geometry serialized as JSON text (Polygon or MultiPolygon). Stored as VARCHAR rather than native GEOMETRY to avoid the DuckDB spatial-extension dependency; can be migrated to native if spatial queries are needed. NULL for no-geometry rows. Lengths range ~960 to ~8700 chars.
columns.Has_Geometry: TRUE for the 72 districts with a polygon, FALSE for the 11 charter / special / merger-remnant districts. Indexable; use this rather than 'Geometry_GeoJSON IS NOT NULL' for filtering.
columns.Centroid_Lon: Geographic centroid longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), computed via shapely.geometry.shape(geometry).centroid. Use for label placement and bubble-map positioning. More accurate than the bounding-box midpoint for irregular shapes (Charleston, Horry). NULL for no-geometry rows.
columns.Centroid_Lat: Geographic centroid latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), computed via shapely. NULL for no-geometry rows.
columns.Match_Method: How the District_ID-to-GEOID mapping was determined. Values: 'normalized' (deterministic name match), 'normalized_with_merger' (name match with shapely.unary_union of an additional historical polygon — currently only Florence 01 carrying pre-2013 Florence 4 territory), 'unmatched_scde_only' (SCDE district with no GeoJSON polygon, Has_Geometry=FALSE).
columns.Match_Confidence: Confidence band for the match: 'high' (deterministic), 'medium' (heuristic), 'low' (manual review needed), 'none' (no geometry to match). All current rows are 'high' or 'none'.
columns.Notes: Free-text supplementary notes. Populated for: Florence 01 (Florence 4 merger context); all 11 no-geometry rows (explanation of why no boundary exists). NULL for the 71 standard 'normalized' geometry rows.
columns.Source_File: Path to the GeoJSON file the geometry was loaded from. Defaults to 'data/geo/sc_districts.geojson'.
columns.Loaded_At: Timestamp when this row was inserted into the canonical table. Auto-populated by DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.

lea_wpu_category.purpose: Category-level Weighted Pupil Unit detail extracted from the Financial Requirements sheet of each WPU135 file. Enables the SAC What-If formula engine to apply per-category statute weights (e.g., SPED 2.60 → 2.75) and compute district-level impact. One row per (District_ID, Fiscal_Year, Report_Cycle, Category). Load script: scripts/load_lea_wpu_category.py
lea_wpu_category.source: WPU13521-WPU13524 Financial Requirements sheets (FY2021-FY2024, full categorical breakdown) plus WPU 13525 'WPU' sheet (FY2025, district totals only). 135-day cycle. 9 canonical categories for FY21-FY24; single 'TOTAL' synthetic category for FY25.
load_caveats: FY25 has no Financial Requirements sheet — the source file only carries district-total WPU. Loaded as Category='TOTAL' with ADM=Weighted_Pupils (implied weight=1.0). The What-If engine treats this as a degraded total-only mode where per-category weight dialing is disabled in the UI.

FY21 and FY22 source files use legacy pre-merger district names (Bamberg 01/02 before merge, Barnwell 19/29, Clarendon 01/02/04 before merge into Clarendon 06). Those rows fail the dim_district name join and are dropped at load time. FY21 and FY22 coverage is therefore lower than FY23+ (~70 districts vs. 76).

RTF (Residential Treatment Facility, weight=2.10) is not present in the Financial Requirements sheet; RTF WPUs flow through a separate allocation mechanism and are missing from this table. The POVERTY row captures PIP (Pupils in Poverty, weight=0.50). GIFTED captures HIAC (Highly Able/Gifted, weight=0.15). HB (Homebound, weight=1.00) is absorbed into BASE_K12 because its implied weight equals the base weight.
DUAL enrollment rows (Dual-enrolled students) appear in the Financial Requirements sheet with Weighted_Pupils=0 (not funded via WPU formula); they are excluded from this table.

Charter district WPU totals (4701, 4801, 4901) will not reconcile to lea_wpu_allocations.Weighted_Pupils because the 135-day allocation total includes CHARTER_BM and CHARTER_VIRT allocations computed at the 45-day cycle from a separate source. Additionally, a residual (~155 RTF students for 4701, ~104 for 4801) flows outside the Financial Requirements sheet.

Barnwell consolidation: 0645 and 0648 still appear here as separate districts because the WPU source file uses legacy IDs. The What-If engine sums them into 0601 at fetch time when base_fy >= 2024 per the saved user preference; this denormalization stays at the engine layer rather than the data layer to preserve raw provenance.
Source xlsx uses trailing whitespace (~40 spaces) on district name cells; join to dim_district via strip() on long_name.

source_label_mapping.BASE_K12: KINDERGARTEN, PRIMARY, ELEMENTARY, HIGH SCHOOL, HB
source_label_mapping.SPED: AUT, EH, EM H, HH, LD, OH, SP H, TM, VH
source_label_mapping.RTF: (not in source file — column will be absent for this FY)
source_label_mapping.TOTAL: (FY25 only — district-total WPU passthrough from the 'WPU' sheet of WPU 13525.xlsx; ADM = Weighted_Pupils, implied weight=1.0)

columns.District_ID: Zero-padded 4-digit SC district ID. Joins to dim_district.District_ID.
columns.Fiscal_Year: Fiscal year (4-digit ending year, e.g., 2024). Must match Report_Cycle — 135-day data is the funding-final measure.
columns.Report_Cycle: Days into the school year when the count was taken. Currently always 135 (funding-final). The 45-day charter categories (CHARTER_BM, CHARTER_VIRT) are loaded from the 45-day WPU file; this table does not carry 45-day rows.
columns.Category: Canonical category label: BASE_K12, SPED, RTF, CTE, CHARTER_BM, CHARTER_VIRT, GIFTED, ACAD_ASSIST, LEP, POVERTY (FY21-FY24); TOTAL for FY25 (single synthetic category covering the full district, since the FY25 source has no per-category breakdown). Each maps to a specific statute weight in the SAC formula (FY26 Funding Manual p.13).
columns.ADM: Raw unweighted student count (135-day Average Daily Membership) for this category, summed across all source row labels that roll into the canonical Category. Populated from the '135 Day ADM' column of the Financial Requirements sheet.
columns.Weighted_Pupils: ADM × statute weight for the category, summed from source sheet. Equals sum of the 'Weighted Pupils' column in the Financial Requirements sheet. BASE_K12 and HB have weight 1.00 so ADM = Weighted_Pupils. To apply a What-If weight: Weighted_Pupils_New = ADM × new_weight.
columns.Source_Row_Labels: Comma-separated list of source xlsx row labels that contributed to this Category row. Provenance trace for audit. Example: 'AUT, EH, EM H, HH, LD, OH, SP H, TM, VH' for SPED.

lea_ita.purpose: Index of Taxpaying Ability (ITA) reference table used in the SAC equalization formula. Each row is one district for one Index Year. ITA values sum to 1.0 statewide and represent each district's share of assessed property wealth. Charter authorizers (4701/4801/4901) are correctly absent — they have no local tax base.
lea_ita.source: SC_Index_of_Taxpaying_Ability_2025.csv · 73 rows · Index Year 2025 (Tax Year 2023 property values)

columns.District_ID: Zero-padded 4-digit SC district ID. PRIMARY KEY with Index_Year. Joins to dim_district.District_ID.
columns.Index_Year: ITA publication year (e.g., 2025). Part of the composite primary key (District_ID, Index_Year).
columns.Tax_Year: Property tax assessment year underlying this ITA value (e.g., 2023). Typically lags Index_Year by 2 years.
columns.District_Fiscal_Capacity: District assessed property value used to compute the ITA (dollars). Source: SC Department of Revenue assessment rolls.
columns.Statewide_Fiscal_Capacity: Total statewide assessed property value for the Tax_Year. Constant within an Index_Year; all 73 districts share the same value.
columns.Index_of_Taxpaying_Ability: Each district's share of statewide fiscal capacity (District_Fiscal_Capacity / Statewide_Fiscal_Capacity). Values sum to 1.0 (±0.001) across all districts in an Index_Year. The equalization input used in the SAC What-If formula engine.
